name: tims
description: TIMS - Thermal Intelligence & Monitoring System (SIH26162, Bhopal pilot)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:boundary && npm run db:seed
scripts.pipeline: npm --prefix backend run osm:sync && npm --prefix backend run firms:ingest
scripts.ml:train: npm run ml:export && npm run ml:eda && npm run ml:labels && python ml/train_model.py
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
